lines.beaver: 지은 씨, 쉬는 날에 보통 뭐 해요?
lines.beaver_en: Jieun, what do you usually do on your days off?
lines.beaver_roman: Jieun ssi, swineun nare botong mwo haeyo?
lines.learner: 음, 전 쉬는 날에 공원에서 산책해요.
lines.en: Hmm, on my days off I take a walk in the park.
lines.roman: Eum, jeon swineun nare gongwoneseo sanchaekaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: A walk sounds nice. Do you take photos too?
lines.learner: 네, 사진도 찍어요. 공원 사진이 제일 좋아요.
lines.en: Yes, I take photos too. Park photos are my favorite.
lines.roman: Ne, sajindo jjigeoyo. Gongwon sajini jeil joayo.

lines.beaver_en: And what else do you do?
lines.learner: 집에서 책을 읽어요. 그리고 목도리도 짜요.
lines.en: I read books at home. And I knit scarves too.
lines.roman: Jibeseo chaegeul ilgeoyo. Geurigo mokdorido jjayo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, a scarf? Who is it for?
lines.en: It's for my grandma. It's a gift for her.

lines.beaver_en: That's cool! Don't you play games?
lines.en: I do. In the evening I play games with my sibling.

lines.learner: 축구 게임이요. 민수 씨는 취미가 뭐예요?
lines.en: A soccer game. Minsu, what's your hobby?
lines.roman: Chukgu geimiyo. Minsu ssineun chwimiga mwoyeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Mine is cooking. Shall we go out together this weekend?
lines.en: Sure! Then let's go to the park together.

lines.beaver_en: Great. What time shall we meet?
lines.en: Let me see, how about 2 p.m.?

lines.beaver_en: Good. Should we invite other friends too?
lines.learner: 네, 모두 같이 사진 찍고 놀아요.
lines.en: Yes, let's all take photos and have fun together.
lines.roman: Ne, modu gachi sajin jjikgo norayo.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. Then see you at the park on Saturday!
lines.learner: 네, 토요일에 봐요. 좋은 주말 보내세요!
lines.en: Yes, see you Saturday. Have a nice weekend!
lines.roman: Ne, toyoire bwayo. Joeun jumal bonaeseyo!
